1.web: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.asv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.

2.web: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
2.asv: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mentionof youin our prayers;

3.web: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
3.asv: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father;

4.web: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
4.asv: knowing, brethren beloved of God, your election,

5.web: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.
5.asv: how that our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and in much assurance; even as ye know what manner of men we showed ourselves toward you for your sake.

6.web: You became imitators of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
6.asv: And ye became imitators of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit;

7.web: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
7.asv: so that ye became an ensample to all that believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

8.web: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out; so that we need not to say anything.
8.asv: For from you hath sounded forth the word of the Lord, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your faith to God-ward is gone forth; so that we need not to speak anything.

9.web: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you; and how you turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God,
9.asv: For they themselves report concerning us what manner of entering in we had unto you; and how ye turned unto God from idols, to serve a living and true God,

10.web: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead—Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
10.asv: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, who delivereth us from the wrath to come.
